# The internal C-ABI seam.  Generated by `./res/check/seam.janet`; do not edit.
#
# Every `c.janet_*` name spelled in Zig code under `src/` and `test/`,
# with what it resolves to.  Comments are stripped before counting, because
# a comment about an abi retired two phases ago reads as a call.
#
# `export fn`, `@export` and `export data` are the three mechanisms Zig
# publishes a symbol by, and every row is one of them: the runtime calling
# its own Zig through the C ABI, which cannot carry an error union and
# cannot inline.  A name that resolves to none of the three is a finding.
#
# The `macro` mechanism and the `header` column went with `janet.h` at
# increment 5f; `seam.janet` records what they were for.
